sn45.164:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these three kinds of existence.
sn45.164:1.3: Sense-sphere existence, form-sphere existence, formless-sphere existence.
sn45.164:1.4: These are the three kinds of existence.
sn45.164:1.5: The Noble Eightfold Path is to be developed for direct knowledge of these three kinds of existence, for the full understanding of them, for their utter destruction, for their abandoning.”
